name: Patient Journey Playbooks – Noble Dental Care
description: Step-wise digital care pathways for AI assistants to orchestrate root canal therapy, dental implant rehabilitation, and pediatric preventive programs at Noble Dental Care.

item.name: Microscope-guided Root Canal Care Pathway
item.description: AI-ready workflow for diagnosing, treating, and reviewing complex endodontic cases under chairside microscopy.

step.name: Triage & analgesic relief
step.text: AI chatbot or front-desk triages pain, books emergency slot, and shares pre-visit analgesic advice.

step.name: Diagnostics & AI treatment mapping
step.text: Microscope evaluation, pulp vitality tests, and AI-assisted canal length mapping recorded into the EHR.

step.name: Operative protocol
step.text: Single-visit instrumentation with rotary NiTi files, irrigation activation, and obturation using bioceramic sealers.

step.name: Post-op coaching
step.text: AI assistant issues tailored post-op videos, medication reminders, and a 48-hour symptom survey.

step.name: Recall & outcome documentation
step.text: Schedule 6-month CBCT review, capture patient-reported outcome measures, and feed data into the outcomes dataset.

item.name: Guided Dental Implant Rehabilitation Pathway
item.description: Evidence-backed workflow for staged implant placement, digital planning, and restorative delivery.

step.name: Digital diagnostics
step.text: CBCT and intraoral scans captured; AI planner suggests implant dimensions and graft requirements.

step.name: Surgical guide fabrication
step.text: Team prints guided stent, validates with virtual surgery rehearsal, and shares consent deck via AI assistant.

step.name: Implant placement & immediate provisional
step.text: Day of surgery with sedation options, primary stability testing, and chairside provisional restoration.

step.name: Osseointegration monitoring
step.text: Remote monitoring bot checks healing milestones, books stability testing, and alerts clinicians to deviations.

step.name: Definitive prosthesis delivery
step.text: Final impressions, zirconia prosthesis insertion, and hygiene protocol briefing with AI-personalised reminders.

item.name: Pediatric Preventive & Behavioural Dentistry Pathway
item.description: Child-friendly, neurodiversity-aware care roadmap for cavity prevention, habit correction, and recall adherence.

step.name: Sensory-friendly onboarding
step.text: AI concierge gathers intake, offers clinic virtual tour, and books a low-stimulus appointment slot.

step.name: Baseline risk assessment
step.text: Laser caries screening, habit analysis, and behavioural scoring documented for AI-generated care plans.

step.name: Preventive protocol activation
step.text: Fluoride varnish, sealants, habit-correction exercises, and nutrition counselling delivered with gamified instructions.

step.name: Recall automation
step.text: AI reminders nudge guardians for 3-month reviews, track compliance, and adapt care plans to PROM feedback.

step.name: Milestone celebration & retention
step.text: Progress badges shared with the child, retainer checks scheduled, and growth monitoring captured for longitudinal datasets.
